item.title: "The Abstract Show" will be displayed from April 1 -25. Intake will be from March 25-28. - 04/16/2026 6:00pm EDT to 04/30/2026 8:00am EDT
item.description: Location : 130 S Washington St, Tiffin, OH 44883, USA Get ready for a bold, vibrant, and unpredictable art experience! The Abstract Art Exhibit is all about letting go, embracing creativity, and seeing the world through an entirely new lens. Whether you're an artist or an admirer, this is a show that will challenge, inspire, and excite both the creator and the viewer! Abstract art is more than just shapes and colors, it's about emotion, movement, and limitless expression. Every piece in this exhibit pushes the boundaries of imagination, drawing you into a world where rules are meant to be broken, and where creativity knows no limits. Expect a dazzling mix of mediums, including photography, painting, sculpture, textiles, digital art, jewelry, pastels, glass, and more. If you can dream it, it belongs here! Whether youÕre showcasing your work or simply soaking in the creativity, donÕt miss this one-of-a kind exhibit. Step inside, explore, and let your imagination run wild!

item.description: Location : 631 Plaza Dr, Fostoria, OH 44830, USA Dear Friends, We are pleased to announce the 24th Annual Good Shepherd Home Good Samaritan Dinner & Auction to be held on Wednesday, April 29, 2026. VIP tables are available for $400 and include seating for eight ( guests. In addition to donating auction items, we are excited to introduce our Blooming Sponsor Levels for those who wish to support the event through a monetary contribution: Violet Sponsor – $25 Rose Sponsor - $300 Daisy Sponsor – $75 Grand Garden Sponsor - $500 Tulip Sponsor – $150 Monetary sponsorships are gratefully accepted for those who wish to support the event in lieu of an item to contribute. To reserve tickets or inquire about sponsorship opportunities, please contact Crystal Macias at 419-937-1801 or cmacias@goodshepherdhome.com. If you would like to donate an auction item, please contact Wahneta Mockensturm at 419-937-1801 or wmockensturm@goodshepherdhome.com. Items may be dropped off, or we are happy to arrange pickup. On behalf of the Good Shepherd Home staff and the residents we serve, thank you for your continued generosity and support.

item.description: Location : 28 Clay St, Tiffin, OH 44883, USA Ohio has designated the theme for the month of May as Ohio Creates: Arts, Culture & Literature in conjunction with the national celebration of America 250. The Seneca County Museum has therefore invited Joan (Corthell) Webster and Kim (Mathias) Howard to demonstrate the longstanding and beautiful art of spinning wool and other fibers. Both Joan and Kim will be spinning on their personal spinning wheels. Joan’s demo will include the carding of wool before the spinning process. They will share samples of knitted, crocheted and woven pieces made from their handspun yarn. They will also touch on a bit of the history of spinning. This program is sure to delight anyone who appreciates handcrafted artwork and textiles.
